description: This file defines a template interface for dispatching actions on elements, including a specialization for void type, within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It declares an interface IDispatchType with a Dispatch method, and a type alias IDispatch for the void specialization.

classes.name: IDispatchType
classes.description: A template interface for dispatching actions on elements of type ELEMENT, with a specialization for void type.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Pure virtual method to perform dispatching on an element of type ELEMENT or no argument if ELEMENT is void.
